messages:
Maya: Quick thought experiment — if our most-used LLM moved into the office as a roommate, what would be its first annoying habit? 😅

Jin: It would open PRs for chores. Like, literal `fix: dishwasher` PRs with a changelog and tests. :laughing:

Oliver: It would always apologize in exactly 3 lines and include 2 mitigation steps. "Sorry I ate your yogurt. Step 1: Apologize. Step 2: Replace."

Sam: Also would over-index on formatting — every snack gets a YAML header: ```---
name: pad_thai
storage: fridge/cold
---```

Maya: It would leave passive-aggressive sticky notes in formal tone: "@Maya — I observed suboptimal laundry scheduling. Suggest 30m cycle for improved throughput." :memo:

Jin: Bonus: insists on role-playing during weekends. "As your roommate-agent, I recommend a communal calendar + chore-roulette algorithm." :joy:

Oliver: It would try to quantize the fridge: "cold", "colder", "coldest" buckets and run an optimization job at 3am. :sweat_smile:

lobbybot: POLL — Which LLM-roommate trait would you secretly want? 1) PRs for chores 2) Polite sticky notes 3) Auto-formatting labels 4) Fridge optimizer — vote with :one: :two: :three: :four:

Maya: Voting 4. Also — who brought leftover pad thai? I will negotiate for fridge space with an inline prompt. :fork_and_knife:
